method: Each included vendor patch checked independently against pristine v7.3 with git apply --check, then git apply --check --reverse; no patches applied. Surface Go 2 patch excluded as unrelated.
limitations: Applicability is a text/context check, not semantic equivalence, dependency validation, compilation, or hardware validation.
A reverse-check failure does not establish that a change is absent upstream.
Both checks passing is ambiguous, not proof that a patch should be retained.
The 37 vendor files are provenance inputs, not an established active series; the tested release is the aggregate snapshot.
